support.faq1Q: Are the ingredients in M-Core safe? Does it contain any banned substances?
support.faq1A: Absolutely safe. M-Core is developed in strict compliance with food safety standards. The product's active ingredients are all natural botanical extracts or essential nutrients required by the human body, containing no chemical stimulants or hormones banned by the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA). Whether you are a professional athlete, an amateur, or the general public, it is completely safe for long-term use.
support.faq2Q: Does the product have relevant local certifications?
support.faq2A: Our production facilities and product development strictly adhere to the food safety standards of the Malaysian Ministry of Health (KKM) and possess relevant compliance certifications (such as MESTI, ISO22000, HACCP, and GMP standards) to ensure the safety and high quality of every pack. Meanwhile, we are also actively advancing the JAKIM Halal certification.
support.faq3Q: How should I take M-Core for the best results?
support.faq3A: For daily maintenance, you can take 1 serving (2 Tablets) in the morning or after lunch to maintain all-day energy and regulate your body state. If you have higher demands, it is recommended to take 1 serving 30-45 minutes before 'activity', which allows the core ingredients to reach their peak blood concentration right when you need them. Note: The maximum recommended daily dosage is 2 servings (4 Tablets). Taking more will not necessarily bring additional benefits.
support.faq4Q: Can I take it on an empty stomach? What if I have a sensitive stomach?
support.faq4A: M-Core's formula is gentle and can generally be taken on an empty stomach. However, if your stomach is sensitive, we recommend taking it after meals, which can also help promote the digestion and absorption of the ingredients.
support.faq5Q: How long does it take to see results after taking it?
support.faq5A: Individual responses vary, but typically within 30-60 minutes (immediate effect) after taking it, you will feel an increase in focus, replenished energy, and relieved fatigue. With continuous use for over 3-4 weeks (long-term effect), your overall stamina, explosive power, and daily anti-fatigue ability will improve. During nighttime activities, desire, performance, and mutual satisfaction will experience positive changes. Some users may feel positive changes within 1 to 2 weeks.
support.faq6Q: Who is M-Core suitable for? Can women take it?
support.faq6A: M-Core is a health conditioning product specifically designed for men, suitable for men of any age from 20 to 65, especially workplace elites and fitness enthusiasts who experience high daily work pressure and fatigue. This product is not suitable for women.
support.faq7Q: Can M-Core be used with other supplements (like whey protein, creatine, fish oil, etc.)?
support.faq7A: Absolutely. M-Core does not conflict with basic supplements. If you are taking other functional products, medications, or products containing stimulating ingredients, we recommend a 2-hour interval to prevent interference with absorption.
support.faq8Q: Does M-Core contain caffeine? Will taking it before night training affect sleep?
support.faq8A: M-Core contains an appropriate amount of natural caffeine extracted from plants to enhance focus and relieve fatigue. If you are sensitive to caffeine, we suggest avoiding it within 4-6 hours before bedtime, or trying half the dosage first before gradually returning to the normal dosage.
support.faq9Q: Can people with the 'three highs' (high blood pressure, high blood sugar, high cholesterol) or sensitive hearts take it?
support.faq9A: Although M-Core's ingredients are naturally sourced, because it significantly optimizes blood circulation, stimulates physical vitality, and accelerates metabolism, we strongly recommend that people with severe cardiovascular diseases, high blood pressure, or those taking related prescription drugs consult a professional physician before taking it. Safety is always our top priority.
support.faq10Q: Can women who are preparing for pregnancy, pregnant, or breastfeeding take it?
support.faq10A: Women preparing for pregnancy, currently pregnant, or breastfeeding are in a special physiological stage. We do not recommend taking any supplements of this type that significantly optimize blood circulation, stimulate physical vitality, and accelerate metabolism.

support.faq15Q: Are there any side effects from taking M-Core?
support.faq15A:
M-Core is a high-quality, food-grade nutritional supplement containing no drugs, hormones, or banned ingredients. For healthy individuals, long-term use at the recommended dosage has no side effects. However, because everyone's constitution and tolerance to natural active ingredients vary, some users may experience the following brief, normal physiological responses upon initial use, which are not side effects:
1. Slight warmth (most common): This is the active ingredients promoting nitric oxide synthesis and accelerating microvascular circulation. It usually appears within 15-30 minutes after ingestion and disappears naturally. As the body adapts over a few days, this sensation will diminish.
2. Mild stomach warmth: A few people with sensitive stomachs may feel this when taking it on an empty stomach. Taking it after a meal will prevent this.
Note: If any allergic reactions or discomfort occur, please stop taking it immediately and consult a professional doctor. Your safety is our top priority!
support.faq16Q: I habitually drink black coffee/energy drinks every morning. Will this conflict with M-Core?
support.faq16A: M-Core operates on a different mechanism than caffeine; it focuses on optimizing blood circulation and deep bodily (cellular and androgenic) energy. You can drink coffee as usual, but to avoid affecting absorption, we suggest spacing out your coffee and M-Core intake by 1 hour or more.
support.faq17Q: Can I drink alcohol while taking M-Core?
support.faq17A: We strongly advise against taking M-Core simultaneously with alcohol. M-Core significantly promotes vasodilation and blood circulation. Drinking a large amount of alcohol within a short time before or after taking it will accelerate the absorption of alcohol into the blood, potentially making you drunk faster or causing drastic heart rate fluctuations. Furthermore, alcohol will likely negatively impact your intimate performance. If you plan to have a light drink to set the mood that night, it will not have a major impact.
support.faq18Q: Will long-term use of M-Core burden the liver or kidneys?
support.faq18A: As long as you follow the recommended dosage, not at all. Liver and kidney burdens are typically caused by high doses of chemically synthesized drugs, heavy metals, or excessive artificial additives. M-Core utilizes high-purity, highly bioavailable natural extract ingredients that can be efficiently metabolized and utilized by the human body without accumulating non-degradable toxins.
support.faq19Q: I've heard that taking too many energy supplements can cause hair loss. Will M-Core cause hair loss?
support.faq19A: Absolutely not. Rumors on the internet about 'supplements causing hair loss' usually target specific banned substances or hormone precursors that drastically alter the body's Dihydrotestosterone (DHT) hormone levels. M-Core's mechanism naturally conditions androgens, optimizes blood microcirculation, and cellular energy. It does not involve any forced alteration of endocrine hormones and therefore will not cause hair loss.
